items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: my father died of the age of, in 1933

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Did your father play music?

My father used to play the carnage. Oh. Yeah, but my father was most, then from a carnage he was a seagull maker, you know what I mean, in New Orleans, you see. And then he took a fishing pole and made a flute out of it, it blew.
